bibliography.title: Preparation and properties of chitosan/organic-modified attapulgite composite proton exchange membranes for fuel cell applications
bibliography.authors: Funding information Hubei provincial department of education, Grant/Award Numbers: Q20192705, 2018ACA152

mechanism_relevant_findings: The proton conductivity of the CS/QATP composite membranes is significantly higher than that of pure chitosan film.

relevance_judgement.reason: The study provides insights into the enhancement of proton conductivity through composite materials.
